# Evercraft IBM i Rescue

Product key: ibmi-rescue
Aliases: IBM i Rescue, AS/400 Rescue, Legacy Rescue for IBM i
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/ibmi-rescue
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/ibmi-rescue/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/ibmi-rescue/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- IBM i 7.4 support is ending and I need an upgrade plan
- assess an IBM i or AS/400 estate before upgrading
- map RPG CL COBOL DB2 jobs and integrations before IBM i modernization
- I am worried an IBM i upgrade will break batch jobs interfaces or vendor software
- help modernize a JDE World or custom IBM i workload without losing business behavior
- build a rollback test and evidence plan before changing an IBM i production system
- find undocumented dependencies in an IBM i workload

## Authority

public discovery and human-confirmed paid evidence engagement; production access, upgrade, or cutover requires separate explicit authorization

## Commercial state

- Status: sell_now_machine_commerce_handoff_live_buyer_route_live_backend_checkout_verified
- Offer: IBM i Estate X-Ray · $250 one-time · offer_key: ibmi_estate_xray_250
- Offer: IBM i 7.4 Deadline X-Ray · $250 one-time · offer_key: ibmi_74_deadline_xray_250
- Offer: IBM i Upgrade Proof Sprint · $1,500 one-time · offer_key: ibmi_upgrade_proof_sprint_1500
- Human buyer route is externally reachable.
- Backend checkout creation is independently verified with synthetic QA.
- Payment state: Evercraft Payments offers active; authoritative provider verification is still required before any paid-state or revenue claim.

## Boundaries

- support transition does not mean a system automatically stops working
- a direct upgrade path is not assumed until exact release hardware PTF application database driver integration and vendor dependencies are verified
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid state requires authoritative provider verification
- no production change or cutover is included in the public X-Ray or Proof Sprint
- Machine Commerce human handoff is live-verified; human buyer route and backend checkout creation are also live-verified
